# teams_translation_rule (Data Source)

Look up an existing TranslationRule object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `pattern` (String) Maps to the -Pattern parameter.
- `translation` (String) Maps to the -Translation parameter.
